svg.text: PMSM Field-Oriented Control · NANOTEC DB42S02 · AURIX TC3xx · 20 kHz
PMSM Field-Oriented Control · DB42S02 · AURIX TC3xx · 20 kHz
Linear ramp: α=0 below 50 rad/s (478 RPM) · α=1 above 250 rad/s (2387 RPM)
Plausibility gate: if |ω_smo − ω_enc_e| > 1000 rad/s elec → substitute encoder. Encoder fallback during 20 ms SMO warmup.
B · Full ISR signal chain (50 µs · 20 kHz)
Speed P-loop: i_q_ref = Kp_speed × (ω_ref − ω_meas_mech) → clamped to ±3.57 A Kp_speed = 0.4 A/(rad/s)
vs PI-FOC: feedforward eliminates steady-state integrator need · no wind-up · faster transients at high speed
Voltage saturation: if ‖[vd, vq]‖ > V_DC/√3 = 9.81 V → proportional scale (preserves MTPA current angle)
Kp_speed 0.4 A/(rad/s) saturates at 8.9 rad/s error
Noise model: ADC 12-bit · PWM spikes · encoder glitch · dead-time · DC bus ripple
EmbedSim — open-source Python-native simulation & MISRA C code generation
Targeting Infineon AURIX TriCore · ARM Cortex-M · ISO 26262 ASIL-D
